items.label: Daily Loss Limit
items.detail: 5% of previous day's end balance. 4% for $200k accounts. Resets daily at 17:00 EST. Intraday profits expand the limit.

items.label: Max Overall Loss
items.detail: 10% of initial balance. 8% for $200k accounts. Equity must never drop below this absolute floor.

items.label: Profit Target P1
items.detail: 8% of initial balance required to pass Phase 1.

items.label: Profit Target P2
items.detail: 5% of initial balance required to pass Phase 2.

items.label: Min Trading Days
items.detail: Must open at least one new trade on 2 separate days per phase before claiming the target.

items.label: Risk Per Trade Idea
items.detail: Max 2% of initial balance per trade idea. Multiple trades on same/correlated asset = 1 idea. New trade within 10 min of closing same asset = same idea. Stop-Loss required. Violation = immediate irrecoverable termination. Effective 7 April 2026.

items.label: Inactivity Limit
items.detail: No new trade opened in 30 consecutive days = account terminated permanently. Closing or modifying SL/TP does not count as activity.

items.label: Time Limit
items.detail: No maximum time to complete the challenge, as long as inactivity rule is respected.

items.label: News Trading – Challenge
items.detail: Full freedom to trade around high-impact news events during Phase 1 and Phase 2.

items.label: News Trading – Funded
items.detail: No open or close within 5 minutes before/after high-impact news. Violation = profit clawback + possible account termination.

items.label: Weekend Hold – Challenge
items.detail: Trades may remain open over the weekend during challenge phases.

items.label: Weekend Hold – Funded
items.detail: All trades must be closed before 15:45 EST Friday. Open positions are auto-closed by the platform.

items.label: Overnight Hold
items.detail: No restrictions on holding positions overnight in any phase including funded.

items.label: Same EA / Multiple Accounts
items.detail: Using the same Expert Advisor across multiple funded accounts simultaneously may trigger suspension.

items.label: 1st Violation
items.detail: Warning issued + excess profits from the over-sized position are clawed back.

items.label: 2nd Violation
items.detail: Excess profits clawed back + profit split reduced to 30% + account terminated immediately.

items.label: Bi-Weekly
items.detail: Requires 3 profitable days within the last 14 days.

items.label: Monthly
items.detail: Requires 7 profitable days within the last 30 days.

items.label: On-Demand
items.detail: Two conditions: (1) Consistency ≤ 40% — biggest winning day ÷ total profit must not exceed 40%. (2) Minimum 2% profit of initial balance must be reached. Example: $11,250 biggest day / $25,000 total = 45% → need $3,125 more to bring ratio to 40%.

items.label: Refund Policy
items.detail: Full challenge fee returned in 4 equal installments of 25% each, paid alongside the first 4 payouts after receiving the funded account.

items.label: Swap-Free
items.detail: Adds 10% to the base challenge fee. Example: $619 challenge → $680.90. Must be selected at purchase, cannot be added later.

items.label: Reset
items.detail: For 2-phase challenges only. On breach, a Reset button appears in the dashboard and restarts from Phase 1. Example: $619 → $804.70. Cannot be added after purchase.

items.label: Max Total Funded
items.detail: Maximum combined balance across all active funded accounts at the same time.

items.label: Merging
items.detail: Funded accounts can only be merged with accounts of the same challenge type (2-Step Pro with 2-Step Pro).

items.label: Platforms
items.value: DX Trade, MT4, MT5, Match Trader, Trade-Locker, CTrader
